storia: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reinstated; backlash over Trump's role, security clearance and board scrutiny continues
angoli_fatti: Six days after the board said no, one weekend of White House pressure flipped the decision, added nearly $1 trillion in value, and set up a Senate hearing on Dec 3.
The morning after: Huang's all-hands apology and therapy, the board under scrutiny, and the 12-day countdown to three Capitol Hill appearances.
novita_oggi: Washington Post reports Hegseth and Pentagon officials floated a wartime law to reappoint him; Trump says a pardon is 'always an option'; Reuters reports the administration found he is not a national security threat; Huang back at Nvidia (Denny's welcomes him) and reportedly tells staff 'we are the most apolitical company'.
